assertions.requirement: RFC 0047: a temporary IAM user allowed only ec2:* in us-east-1, us-east-2 and us-west-2, the Spot service-linked role, S3 on the member's output bucket and sts:GetFederationToken; no other IAM action. Its keys are redacted and the user is always deleted.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/credentials-onboarding/aws/admin.ts: restrictedPilotPolicy; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/job-aws-credential.ts: AwsJobImportFixture restrictedBuckets; JobAuthorization aws-restricted cleanup registration.

assertions.requirement: S1: a t3.small Job pinned to us-east-1 reaches Running in us-east-1 and completes with exit code 0, so no IAM call blocked it.
S2: an unpinned c6i.xlarge Job is admitted, runs in one of the three allowed regions and completes with exit code 0.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #restrictedCredentialMember allowed-region check on the live attempt.

assertions.requirement: S3: a Job with a same-account automatic output bucket completes and its marker object is read back from that bucket.
Persisted terminal cleanup, complete attempt history and independent native absence are required for every child before release; only one family completion follows.
